defensiveAbilities.name: Viviparous Birth
defensiveAbilities.description:
When killed, an empress necral worm violently expels the young it carries. These young erupt as a Necral Worm Swarm in the empress necral worm's space.

In addition, every creature within 20 feet takes 5d10 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save) from the splatter of undead viscera.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Borer
offensiveAbilities.description: An empress necral worm can leave a tunnel behind itself when it burrows, and it usually does.

offensiveAbilities.name: Painful Bite
offensiveAbilities.description: The bite of an empress necral worm causes excruciating pain. The target must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1 from the pain (Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Undead Wake
offensiveAbilities.description:
The empress necral worm Strides, leaving behind dribbles of void energy in every square that it passes through.

A creature that enters or begins its turn in such a square takes 3d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save). The void energy becomes inert after 1 minute.
